title: Zesty Glassy French Toffee Popcorn Quiche
description: A cultured, glassy-jelly, one-pot French dish featuring toffee popcorn, shio-koji-cure, and vegan-friendly ingredients in a quiche form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine shio-koji, vegan cream cheese, aquafaba, agave nectar, lemon juice, and salt, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, mix together the blended mixture and toffee popcorn until well combined.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a tart pan with a removable bottom.
Fill the pie crust with the toffee popcorn mixture and smooth the top.
Bake the quiche for 35 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove the quiche from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Refrigerate the quiche for at least 2 hours to allow it to set.
Slice the quiche into wedges and serve chilled.
